1.w: א ( Alef ) How blessed are those whose actions are blameless, who obey the law of the Lord .

2.w: How blessed are those who observe his rules and seek him with all their heart,

3.w: who, moreover, do no wrong, but follow in his footsteps.

4.w: You demand that your precepts be carefully kept.

5.w: If only I were predisposed to keep your statutes.

6.w: Then I would not be ashamed, if I were focused on all your commands.

7.w: I will give you sincere thanks when I learn your just regulations.

8.w: I will keep your statutes. Do not completely abandon me. ב ( Bet )

9.w: How can a young person maintain a pure life? By guarding it according to your instructions.

10.w: With all my heart I seek you. Do not allow me to stray from your commands.

11.w: In my heart I store up your words, so I might not sin against you.

12.w: You deserve praise, O Lord . Teach me your statutes.

13.w: With my lips I proclaim all the regulations you have revealed.

14.w: I rejoice in the lifestyle prescribed by your rules as if they were riches of all kinds.

15.w: I will meditate on your precepts and focus on your behavior.

16.w: I find delight in your statutes; I do not forget your instructions. ג ( Gimel )

17.w: Be kind to your servant. Then I will live and keep your instructions.

18.w: Open my eyes so I can truly see the marvelous things in your law.

19.w: I am a resident foreigner in this land. Do not hide your commands from me.

20.w: I desperately long to know your regulations at all times.

21.w: You reprimand arrogant people. Those who stray from your commands are doomed.

22.w: Spare me shame and humiliation, for I observe your rules.

23.w: Though rulers plot and slander me, your servant meditates on your statutes.

24.w: Yes, I find delight in your rules; they give me guidance. ד ( Dalet )

25.w: I collapse in the dirt. Revive me with your word.

26.w: I told you about my ways and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

27.w: Help me to understand what your precepts mean. Then I can meditate on your marvelous teachings.

28.w: I collapse from grief. Sustain me by your word.

29.w: Remove me from the path of deceit. Graciously give me your law.

30.w: I choose the path of faithfulness; I am committed to your regulations.

31.w: I hold fast to your rules. O Lord , do not let me be ashamed.

32.w: I run along the path of your commands, for you enable me to do so. ה ( He )

33.w: Teach me, O Lord , the lifestyle prescribed by your statutes so that I might observe it continually.

34.w: Give me understanding so that I might observe your law and keep it with all my heart.

35.w: Guide me in the path of your commands, for I delight to walk in it.

36.w: Give me a desire for your rules, rather than for wealth gained unjustly.

37.w: Turn my eyes away from what is worthless. Revive me with your word.

38.w: Confirm to your servant your promise, which you made to the one who honors you.

39.w: Take away the insults that I dread. Indeed, your regulations are good.

40.w: Look, I long for your precepts. Revive me with your deliverance. ו ( Vav )

41.w: May I experience your loyal love, O Lord , and your deliverance, as you promised.

42.w: Then I will have a reply for the one who insults me, for I trust in your word.

43.w: Do not completely deprive me of a truthful testimony, for I await your justice.

44.w: Then I will keep your law continually now and for all time.

45.w: I will be secure, for I seek your precepts.

46.w: I will speak about your regulations before kings and not be ashamed.

47.w: I will find delight in your commands, which I love.

48.w: I will lift my hands to your commands, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes. ז ( Zayin )

49.w: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.

50.w: This is what comforts me in my trouble, for your promise revives me.

51.w: Arrogant people do nothing but scoff at me. Yet I do not turn aside from your law.

52.w: I remember your ancient regulations, O Lord , and console myself.

53.w: Rage takes hold of me because of the wicked, those who reject your law.

54.w: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

55.w: I remember your name during the night, O Lord , and I will keep your law.

56.w: This has been my practice, for I observe your precepts. ח ( Khet )

57.w: The Lord is my source of security. I have determined to follow your instructions.

58.w: I seek your favor with all my heart. Have mercy on me as you promised.

59.w: I consider my actions and follow your rules.

60.w: I keep your commands eagerly and without delay.

61.w: The ropes of the wicked tighten around me, but I do not forget your law.

62.w: In the middle of the night I arise to thank you for your just regulations.

63.w: I am a friend to all your loyal followers and to those who keep your precepts.

64.w: O Lord , your loyal love fills the earth. Teach me your statutes! ט ( Tet )

65.w: You are good to your servant, O Lord , just as you promised.

66.w: Teach me proper discernment and understanding. For I consider your commands to be reliable.

67.w: Before I was afflicted I used to stray off, but now I keep your instructions.

68.w: You are good and you do good. Teach me your statutes.

69.w: Arrogant people smear my reputation with lies, but I observe your precepts with all my heart.

70.w: Their hearts are calloused, but I find delight in your law.

71.w: It was good for me to suffer so that I might learn your statutes.

72.w: The law you have revealed is more important to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. י ( Yod )

73.w: Your hands made me and formed me. Give me understanding so that I might learn your commands.

74.w: Your loyal followers will be glad when they see me, for I find hope in your word.

75.w: I know, Lord , that your regulations are just. You disciplined me because of your faithful devotion to me.

76.w: May your loyal love console me, as you promised your servant.

77.w: May I experience your compassion so I might live. For I find delight in your law.

78.w: May the arrogant be humiliated, for they have slandered me. But I meditate on your precepts.

79.w: May your loyal followers turn to me, those who know your rules.

80.w: May I be fully committed to your statutes, so that I might not be ashamed. כ ( Kaf )

81.w: I desperately long for your deliverance. I find hope in your word.

82.w: My eyes grow tired as I wait for your promise to be fulfilled. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

83.w: For I am like a wineskin dried up in smoke. I do not forget your statutes.

84.w: How long must your servant endure this? When will you judge those who pursue me?

85.w: The arrogant dig pits to trap me, which violates your law.

86.w: All your commands are reliable. I am pursued without reason. Help me!

87.w: They have almost destroyed me here on the earth, but I do not reject your precepts.

88.w: Revive me with your loyal love that I might keep the rules you have revealed. ל ( Lamed )

89.w: O Lord , your instructions endure; they stand secure in heaven.

90.w: You demonstrate your faithfulness to all generations. You established the earth and it stood firm.

91.w: Today they stand firm by your decrees, for all things are your servants.

92.w: If I had not found encouragement in your law, I would have died in my sorrow.

93.w: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have revived me.

94.w: I belong to you. Deliver me! For I seek your precepts.

95.w: The wicked prepare to kill me, yet I concentrate on your rules.

96.w: I realize that everything has its limits, but your commands are beyond full comprehension. מ ( Mem )

97.w: O how I love your law! All day long I meditate on it.

98.w: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for I am always aware of them.

99.w: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your rules.

100.w: I am more discerning than those older than I, for I observe your precepts.

101.w: I stay away from every evil path, so that I might keep your instructions.

102.w: I do not turn aside from your regulations, for you teach me.

103.w: Your words are sweeter in my mouth than honey!

104.w: Your precepts give me discernment. Therefore I hate all deceitful actions. נ ( Nun )

105.w: Your word is a lamp to walk by and a light to illumine my path.

106.w: I have vowed and solemnly sworn to keep your just regulations.

107.w: I am suffering terribly. O Lord , revive me with your word.

108.w: O Lord , please accept the freewill offerings of my praise. Teach me your regulations.

109.w: My life is in continual danger, but I do not forget your law.

110.w: The wicked lay a trap for me, but I do not wander from your precepts.

111.w: I claim your rules as my permanent possession, for they give me joy.

112.w: I am determined to obey your statutes at all times, to the very end. ס ( Samek )

113.w: I hate people with divided loyalties, but I love your law.

114.w: You are my hiding place and my shield. I find hope in your word.

115.w: Turn away from me, you evil men, so that I can observe the commands of my God.

116.w: Sustain me as you promised, so that I will live. Do not disappoint me.

117.w: Support me so that I will be delivered. Then I will focus on your statutes continually.

118.w: You despise all who stray from your statutes, for such people are deceptive and unreliable.

119.w: You remove all the wicked of the earth like slag. Therefore I love your rules.

120.w: My body trembles because I fear you; I am afraid of your judgments. ע ( Ayin )

121.w: I do what is fair and right. Do not abandon me to my oppressors.

122.w: Guarantee the welfare of your servant. Do not let the arrogant oppress me.

123.w: My eyes grow tired as I wait for your deliverance, for your reliable promise to be fulfilled.

124.w: Show your servant your loyal love. Teach me your statutes.

125.w: I am your servant. Give me insight, so that I can understand your rules.

126.w: It is time for the Lord to act— they break your law.

127.w: For this reason I love your commands more than gold, even purest gold.

128.w: For this reason I carefully follow all your precepts. I hate all deceitful actions. פ ( Pe )

129.w: Your rules are marvelous. Therefore I observe them.

130.w: Your instructions are a doorway through which light shines. They give insight to the untrained.

131.w: I open my mouth and pant, because I long for your commands.

132.w: Turn toward me and extend mercy to me, as you typically do to your loyal followers.

133.w: Direct my steps by your word. Do not let any sin dominate me.

134.w: Deliver me from oppressive men, so that I can keep your precepts.

135.w: Smile on your servant. Teach me your statutes!

136.w: Tears stream down from my eyes, because people do not keep your law. צ ( Tsade )

137.w: You are just, O Lord , and your judgments are fair.

138.w: The rules you impose are just and absolutely reliable.

139.w: My zeal consumes me, for my enemies forget your instructions.

140.w: Your word is absolutely pure, and your servant loves it.

141.w: I am insignificant and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.

142.w: Your justice endures, and your law is reliable.

143.w: Distress and hardship confront me, yet I find delight in your commands.

144.w: Your rules remain just. Give me insight so that I can live. ק ( Qof )

145.w: I cried out with all my heart, “Answer me, O Lord ! I will observe your statutes.”

146.w: I cried out to you, “Deliver me, so that I can keep your rules.”

147.w: I am up before dawn crying for help. I find hope in your word.

148.w: My eyes anticipate the nighttime hours so that I can meditate on your word.

149.w: Listen to me because of your loyal love. O Lord , revive me, as you typically do.

150.w: Those who are eager to do wrong draw near; they are far from your law.

151.w: You are near, O Lord , and all your commands are reliable.

152.w: I learned long ago that you ordained your rules to last. ר ( Resh )

153.w: See my pain and rescue me. For I do not forget your law.

154.w: Fight for me and defend me. Revive me with your word.

155.w: The wicked have no chance for deliverance, for they do not seek your statutes.

156.w: Your compassion is great, O Lord . Revive me, as you typically do.

157.w: The enemies who chase me are numerous. Yet I do not turn aside from your rules.

158.w: I take note of the treacherous and despise them, because they do not keep your instructions.

159.w: See how I love your precepts. O Lord , revive me with your loyal love.

160.w: Your instructions are totally reliable; all your just regulations endure. ש ( Sin/Shin )

161.w: Rulers pursue me for no reason, yet I am more afraid of disobeying your instructions.

162.w: I rejoice in your instructions, like one who finds much plunder.

163.w: I hate and despise deceit; I love your law.

164.w: Seven times a day I praise you because of your just regulations.

165.w: Those who love your law are completely secure; nothing causes them to stumble.

166.w: I hope for your deliverance, O Lord , and I obey your commands.

167.w: I keep your rules; I love them greatly.

168.w: I keep your precepts and rules, for you are aware of everything I do. ת ( Tav )

169.w: Listen to my cry for help, O Lord . Give me insight by your word.

170.w: Listen to my appeal for mercy. Deliver me, as you promised.

171.w: May praise flow freely from my lips, for you teach me your statutes.

172.w: May my tongue sing about your instructions, for all your commands are just.

173.w: May your hand help me, for I choose to obey your precepts.

174.w: I long for your deliverance, O Lord ; I find delight in your law.

175.w: May I live and praise you. May your regulations help me.

176.w: I have wandered off like a lost sheep. Come looking for your servant, for I do not forget your commands.
